default.notes: Apply online for the Mongolian eVisa on evisa.mn before travel; nationalities not eligible for the eVisa must apply through a Mongolian embassy.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days under a permanent bilateral arrangement; stays of more than 30 days must be registered with the Immigration Agency within 48 hours of arrival.
Visa-free for up to 30 days under a bilateral agreement or standing waiver.
Visa-free for up to 21 days under a bilateral arrangement.
Visa-free for up to 30 days under Mongolia's temporary visa-exemption programme, announced through the end of 2025 and since extended — confirm the current status on evisa.mn shortly before travel.

RU.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days per visit (maximum 90 days in any 180-day period) under the Mongolia-Russia agreement.

KR.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days under a temporary exemption that has been extended in stages (reported through 2028) — confirm the current status before travel.

MN.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Mongolian citizens.
